title: Migrate Metabolism Kit Db to Current Schema
description: The metabolism kit.db attribute table is missing tag_guid and concept_guid columns, causing SQLite Error 1: 'no such column: tag_guid' when loading the kit. The schema.sql has these columns but the asset file was not updated.
summary: Fixed the assets/semio/metabolism kit.db to match the current canonical schema. The attribute table was missing tag_guid and concept_guid columns (already patched by the migration run). The type_concept and design_concept tables had a wrong column named 'concept VARCHAR(256)' instead of 'concept_guid VARCHAR(36)' — both were empty so they were dropped and recreated with the correct schema. Added Metabolism_Asset_Kit_Db_Kit test to verify the canonical asset kit.db loads correctly. All 12 tests pass.
